verses.original: וּבֶן־ הֲדַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֗ם קָבַץ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ חֵיל֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וּשְׁנַ֥יִם מֶ֛לֶךְ אִתּ֖וֹ וְס֣וּס וָרָ֑כֶב וַיַּ֗עַל וַיָּ֙צַר֙ עַל־ שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ me·leḵ- ’ă·rām qā·ḇaṣ ’eṯ- kāl- ḥê·lōw ū·šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·na·yim me·leḵ ’it·tōw wə·sūs wā·rā·ḵeḇ way·ya·‘al way·yā·ṣar ‘al- šō·mə·rō·wn way·yil·lā·ḥem bāh
verses.literal: Now Ben-hadad king of Aram assembled his entire army Accompanied by thirty-two . . . kings with their horses and chariots he marched up besieged . . . Samaria and waged war against it

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֧ח מַלְאָכִ֛ים אֶל־ אַחְאָ֥ב מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הָעִֽירָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- ’aḥ·’āḇ me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl hā·‘î·rāh
verses.literal: Then he sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר בֶּן־ הֲדַ֔ד כַּסְפְּךָ֥ וּֽזְהָבְךָ֖ לִֽי־ ה֑וּא וְנָשֶׁ֧יךָ וּבָנֶ֛יךָ הַטּוֹבִ֖ים לִי־ הֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw kōh ’ā·mar ben- hă·ḏaḏ kas·pə·ḵā ū·zə·hā·ḇə·ḵā lî- hū wə·nā·še·ḵā ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇîm lî- hêm
verses.literal: saying This is what Ben-hadad says Your silver and gold are mine and your best wives and children are mine

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַן מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר כִּדְבָרְךָ֖ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ לְךָ֥ אֲנִ֖י וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer kiḏ·ḇā·rə·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ lə·ḵā ’ă·nî wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- lî
verses.literal: And the king of Israel . . . replied Just as you say my lord the king I am yours along with all that I have

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ הַמַּלְאָכִ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר בֶּן־ הֲדַ֖ד לֵאמֹ֑ר כִּֽי־ שָׁלַ֤חְתִּי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כַּסְפְּךָ֧ וּזְהָבְךָ֛ וְנָשֶׁ֥יךָ וּבָנֶ֖יךָ לִ֥י תִתֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šu·ḇū ham·mal·’ā·ḵîm way·yō·mə·rū kōh- ’ā·mar ben- hă·ḏaḏ lê·mōr kî- šā·laḥ·tî ’ê·le·ḵā lê·mōr kas·pə·ḵā ū·zə·hā·ḇə·ḵā wə·nā·še·ḵā ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā lî ṯit·tên
verses.literal: The messengers came back and said This is what Ben-hadad says I have sent to you . . . to demand . . . - your silver your gold your wives and your children

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ אִם־ כָּעֵ֣ת מָחָ֗ר אֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֶת־ עֲבָדַי֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְחִפְּשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣יתְךָ֔ וְאֵ֖ת בָּתֵּ֣י עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ וְהָיָה֙ כָּל־ מַחְמַ֣ד עֵינֶ֔יךָ יָשִׂ֥ימוּ בְיָדָ֖ם וְלָקָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- kā·‘êṯ mā·ḥār ’eš·laḥ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay ’ê·le·ḵā wə·ḥip·pə·śū ’eṯ- bê·ṯə·ḵā wə·’êṯ bāt·tê ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā wə·hā·yāh kāl- maḥ·maḏ ‘ê·ne·ḵā yā·śî·mū ḇə·yā·ḏām wə·lā·qā·ḥū
verses.literal: But about this time tomorrow I will send my servants to search your palace and the houses of your servants They will seize . . . and carry away all that is precious to you

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְכָל־ זִקְנֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ דְּעֽוּ־ נָ֣א וּרְא֔וּ כִּ֥י רָעָ֖ה זֶ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֑שׁ כִּֽי־ שָׁלַ֨ח אֵלַ֜י לְנָשַׁ֤י וּלְבָנַי֙ וּלְכַסְפִּ֣י וְלִזְהָבִ֔י וְלֹ֥א מָנַ֖עְתִּי מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḵāl ziq·nê hā·’ā·reṣ way·yō·mer də·‘ū- nā ū·rə·’ū kî rā·‘āh zeh mə·ḇaq·qêš kî- šā·laḥ ’ê·lay lə·nā·šay ū·lə·ḇā·nay ū·lə·ḵas·pî wə·liz·hā·ḇî wə·lō mā·na‘·tî mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Then the king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land and said Please take note and see that this man is looking for trouble for when he demanded . . . my wives my children my silver and my gold I did not deny him

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלָ֛יו כָּל־ הַזְּקֵנִ֖ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֑ם אַל־ תִּשְׁמַ֖ע וְל֥וֹא תֹאבֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw kāl- haz·zə·qê·nîm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’al- tiš·ma‘ wə·lō·w ṯō·ḇeh
verses.literal: And the elders and the people all said Do not listen to him or consent to his terms

verses.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר לְמַלְאֲכֵ֣י בֶן־ הֲדַ֗ד אִמְר֞וּ לַֽאדֹנִ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֨חְתָּ אֶל־ עַבְדְּךָ֤ בָרִֽאשֹׁנָה֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֔ה וְהַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה לֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ הַמַּלְאָכִ֔ים וַיְשִׁבֻ֖הוּ דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·mal·’ă·ḵê ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ ’im·rū la·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ kōl ’ă·šer- šā·laḥ·tā ’el- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ḇā·ri·šō·nāh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh wə·had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh lō ’ū·ḵal la·‘ă·śō·wṯ way·yê·lə·ḵū ham·mal·’ā·ḵîm way·ši·ḇu·hū dā·ḇār
verses.literal: So Ahab answered the messengers of Ben-hadad Tell my lord the king All that you demanded of your servant the first time I will do but this thing I cannot . . . do So the messengers departed and relayed the message to Ben-hadad . . .

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֵלָיו֙ בֶּן־ הֲדַ֔ד וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כֹּֽה־ יַעֲשׂ֥וּן לִ֛י אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְכֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֑פוּ אִם־ יִשְׂפֹּק֙ עֲפַ֣ר שֹׁמְר֔וֹן לִשְׁעָלִ֕ים לְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּרַגְלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’ê·lāw ben- hă·ḏaḏ way·yō·mer kōh- ya·‘ă·śūn lî ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ḵōh yō·w·si·p̄ū ’im- yiś·pōq ‘ă·p̄ar šō·mə·rō·wn liš·‘ā·lîm lə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer bə·raḡ·lāy
verses.literal: Then Ben-hadad sent another message to Ahab May the gods deal with me and ever so severely if enough dust remains of Samaria for each of my men - to have a handful

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַן מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דַּבְּר֔וּ אַל־ יִתְהַלֵּ֥ל חֹגֵ֖ר כִּמְפַתֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer dab·bə·rū ’al- yiṯ·hal·lêl ḥō·ḡêr kim·p̄at·tê·aḥ
verses.literal: And the king of Israel . . . replied Tell him The one putting on his armor should not boast like one taking it off

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּשְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה וְה֥וּא שֹׁתֶ֛ה ה֥וּא וְהַמְּלָכִ֖ים בַּסֻּכּ֑וֹת וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ עֲבָדָיו֙ שִׂ֔ימוּ וַיָּשִׂ֖ימוּ עַל־ הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh wə·hū šō·ṯeh hū wə·ham·mə·lā·ḵîm bas·suk·kō·wṯ way·yō·mer ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw śî·mū way·yā·śî·mū ‘al- hā·‘îr
verses.literal: Ben-hadad received this message while he and the kings were drinking . . . in their tents and he said to his servants Take your positions So they stationed themselves against the city

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ נָבִ֣יא אֶחָ֗ד נִגַּשׁ֮ אֶל־ אַחְאָ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הְֽרָאִ֔יתָ אֵ֛ת כָּל־ הֶהָמ֥וֹן הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּ֑ה הִנְנִ֨י נֹתְנ֤וֹ בְיָֽדְךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh nā·ḇî ’e·ḥāḏ nig·gaš ’el- ’aḥ·’āḇ me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hə·rā·’î·ṯā ’êṯ kāl- he·hā·mō·wn hag·gā·ḏō·wl haz·zeh hin·nî nō·ṯə·nōw ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā hay·yō·wm wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Meanwhile a prophet approached . . . Ahab king of Israel and declared This is what the LORD says Do you see this entire great army Behold I will deliver it into your hand this very day and you will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אַחְאָב֙ בְּמִ֔י וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בְּנַעֲרֵ֖י שָׂרֵ֣י הַמְּדִינ֑וֹת וַיֹּ֛אמֶר מִֽי־ יֶאְסֹ֥ר הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’aḥ·’āḇ bə·mî way·yō·mer kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh bə·na·‘ă·rê śā·rê ham·mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ way·yō·mer mî- ye’·sōr ham·mil·ḥā·māh way·yō·mer ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: By whom Ahab asked And the prophet replied This is what the LORD says By the young officers of the district governors Who will start the battle asked Ahab You will answered the prophet

verses.original: וַיִּפְקֹ֗ד אֶֽת־ נַעֲרֵי֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הַמְּדִינ֔וֹת וַיִּהְי֕וּ מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁנַ֣יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֑ים וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם פָּקַ֧ד אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֛ם כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·qōḏ ’eṯ- na·‘ă·rê śā·rê ham·mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ way·yih·yū mā·ṯa·yim šə·na·yim ū·šə·lō·šîm wə·’a·ḥă·rê·hem pā·qaḏ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ām kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm
verses.literal: So Ahab assembled the young officers of the district governors and there were 232 men . . . . . . And after them he assembled the rest of the Israelite . . . troops 7,000 . . . in all

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֖וּ בַּֽצָּהֳרָ֑יִם וּבֶן־ הֲדַד֩ שֹׁתֶ֨ה שִׁכּ֜וֹר בַּסֻּכּ֗וֹת ה֧וּא וְהַמְּלָכִ֛ים שְׁלֹשִֽׁים־ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם מֶ֖לֶךְ עֹזֵ֥ר אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū baṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim ū·ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ šō·ṯeh šik·kō·wr bas·suk·kō·wṯ hū wə·ham·mə·lā·ḵîm šə·lō·šîm- ū·šə·na·yim me·leḵ ‘ō·zêr ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: They marched out at noon while Ben-hadad and the 32 . . . . . . kings allied with him were in their tents . . . getting drunk

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֗וּ נַעֲרֵ֛י שָׂרֵ֥י הַמְּדִינ֖וֹת בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח בֶּן־ הֲדַ֗ד וַיַּגִּ֤ידוּ לוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֲנָשִׁ֕ים יָצְא֖וּ מִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū na·‘ă·rê śā·rê ham·mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ bā·ri·šō·nāh way·yiš·laḥ ben- hă·ḏaḏ way·yag·gî·ḏū lōw lê·mōr ’ă·nā·šîm yā·ṣə·’ū miš·šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: And the young officers of the district governors marched out first . . . Now Ben-hadad had sent out scouts who reported to him Men are marching out of Samaria

verses.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר אִם־ לְשָׁל֥וֹם יָצָ֖אוּ תִּפְשׂ֣וּם חַיִּ֑ים וְאִ֧ם לְמִלְחָמָ֛ה יָצָ֖אוּ חַיִּ֥ים תִּפְשֽׂוּם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’im- lə·šā·lō·wm yā·ṣā·’ū tip̄·śūm ḥay·yîm wə·’im lə·mil·ḥā·māh yā·ṣā·’ū ḥay·yîm tip̄·śūm
verses.literal: If they have marched out in peace he said take them alive Even if they have marched out for war take them alive

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ יָצְא֣וּ מִן־ הָעִ֔יר נַעֲרֵ֖י שָׂרֵ֣י הַמְּדִינ֑וֹת וְהַחַ֖יִל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh yā·ṣə·’ū min- hā·‘îr na·‘ă·rê śā·rê ham·mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ wə·ha·ḥa·yil ’ă·šer ’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: Meanwhile, these young officers of the district governors marched out of the city with the army behind them

verses.original: וַיַּכּוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֔וֹ וַיָּנֻ֣סוּ אֲרָ֔ם וַֽיִּרְדְּפֵ֖ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּמָּלֵ֗ט בֶּן־ הֲדַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם עַל־ ס֖וּס וּפָרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yak·kū ’îš ’î·šōw way·yā·nu·sū ’ă·rām way·yir·də·p̄êm yiś·rā·’êl way·yim·mā·lêṭ ben- hă·ḏaḏ me·leḵ ’ă·rām ‘al- sūs ū·p̄ā·rā·šîm
verses.literal: and each one struck down his opponent So the Arameans fled with the Israelites in pursuit But Ben-hadad king of Aram escaped on horseback with the cavalry

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־ הַסּ֖וּס וְאֶת־ הָרָ֑כֶב וְהִכָּ֥ה בַאֲרָ֖ם מַכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl way·yaḵ ’eṯ- has·sūs wə·’eṯ- hā·rā·ḵeḇ wə·hik·kāh ḇa·’ă·rām mak·kāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Then the king of Israel marched out and attacked the horses and chariots inflicting a great slaughter on the Arameans

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֤שׁ הַנָּבִיא֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ לֵ֣ךְ הִתְחַזַּ֔ק וְדַ֥ע וּרְאֵ֖ה אֵ֣ת אֲשֶֽׁר־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה כִּ֚י לִתְשׁוּבַ֣ת הַשָּׁנָ֔ה מֶ֥לֶךְ אֲרָ֖ם עֹלֶ֥ה עָלֶֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gaš han·nā·ḇî ’el- me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer lōw lêḵ hiṯ·ḥaz·zaq wə·ḏa‘ ū·rə·’êh ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ta·‘ă·śeh kî liṯ·šū·ḇaṯ haš·šā·nāh me·leḵ ’ă·rām ‘ō·leh ‘ā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Afterward, the prophet . . . approached the king of Israel and said Go and strengthen your position and take note . . . what you must do for in the spring . . . the king of Aram will come up against you

verses.original: וְעַבְדֵ֨י מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֜ם אָמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָרִים֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם עַל־ כֵּ֖ן חָזְק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְאוּלָ֗ם נִלָּחֵ֤ם אִתָּם֙ בַּמִּישׁ֔וֹר אִם־ לֹ֥א נֶחֱזַ֖ק מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘aḇ·ḏê me·leḵ- ’ă·rām ’ā·mə·rū ’ê·lāw ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·rîm ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem ‘al- kên ḥā·zə·qū mim·men·nū wə·’ū·lām nil·lā·ḥêm ’it·tām bam·mî·šō·wr ’im- lō ne·ḥĕ·zaq mê·hem
verses.literal: Meanwhile, the servants of the king of Aram said to him Their gods are gods of the hills That is why . . . they prevailed over us Instead we should fight them on the plains surely then we will prevail

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה עֲשֵׂ֑ה הָסֵ֤ר הַמְּלָכִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִמְּקֹמ֔וֹ וְשִׂ֥ים פַּח֖וֹת תַּחְתֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ‘ă·śêh hā·sêr ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ’îš mim·mə·qō·mōw wə·śîm pa·ḥō·wṯ taḥ·tê·hem
verses.literal: So do this Dismiss all the kings from their positions and replace them . . . with other officers

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה תִֽמְנֶה־ לְךָ֣׀ חַ֡יִל כַּחַיִל֩ הַנֹּפֵ֨ל מֵאוֹתָ֜ךְ וְס֣וּס כַּסּ֣וּס׀ וְרֶ֣כֶב כָּרֶ֗כֶב וְנִֽלָּחֲמָ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ בַּמִּישׁ֔וֹר אִם־ לֹ֥א נֶחֱזַ֖ק מֵהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע לְקֹלָ֖ם וַיַּ֥עַשׂ כֵּֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ṯim·neh- lə·ḵā ḥa·yil ka·ḥa·yil han·nō·p̄êl mê·’ō·w·ṯāḵ wə·sūs kas·sūs wə·re·ḵeḇ kā·re·ḵeḇ wə·nil·lā·ḥă·māh ’ō·w·ṯām bam·mî·šō·wr ’im- lō ne·ḥĕ·zaq mê·hem way·yiš·ma‘ lə·qō·lām way·ya·‘aś kên
verses.literal: And you must raise an army like the one you have lost horse for horse and chariot for chariot so we can fight the Israelites on the plain where we will surely . . . prevail . . . And the king approved their plan and acted accordingly

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ לִתְשׁוּבַ֣ת הַשָּׁנָ֔ה וַיִּפְקֹ֥ד בֶּן־ הֲדַ֖ד אֶת־ אֲרָ֑ם וַיַּ֣עַל אֲפֵ֔קָה לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî liṯ·šū·ḇaṯ haš·šā·nāh way·yip̄·qōḏ ben- hă·ḏaḏ ’eṯ- ’ă·rām way·ya·‘al ’ă·p̄ê·qāh lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: In the spring . . . Ben-hadad mobilized the Arameans and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הָתְפָּקְדוּ֙ וְכָלְכְּל֔וּ וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ לִקְרָאתָ֑ם וַיַּחֲנ֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל נֶגְדָּ֗ם כִּשְׁנֵי֙ חֲשִׂפֵ֣י עִזִּ֔ים וַאֲרָ֖ם מִלְא֥וּ אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hā·ṯə·pā·qə·ḏū wə·ḵā·lə·kə·lū way·yê·lə·ḵū liq·rā·ṯām way·ya·ḥă·nū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl neḡ·dām kiš·nê ḥă·śi·p̄ê ‘iz·zîm wa·’ă·rām mil·’ū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . also mobilized gathered supplies and marched out to meet them The Israelites . . . camped before them like two small flocks of goats while the Arameans covered the countryside

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֞שׁ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים וַיֹּאמֶר֮ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֹּ֜אמֶר כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה יַ֠עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמְר֤וּ אֲרָם֙ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָרִים֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ אֱלֹהֵ֥י עֲמָקִ֖ים ה֑וּא וְ֠נָתַתִּי אֶת־ כָּל־ הֶהָמ֨וֹן הַגָּ֤דוֹל הַזֶּה֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gaš ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·mer ’el- me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ya·‘an ’ă·šer ’ā·mə·rū ’ă·rām ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·rîm Yah·weh wə·lō- ’ĕ·lō·hê ‘ă·mā·qîm hū wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- kāl- he·hā·mō·wn hag·gā·ḏō·wl haz·zeh bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the man of God approached the king of Israel and said This is what the LORD says Because the Arameans have said that the LORD is a god of the hills and not of the valleys . . . I will deliver all this great army into your hand Then you will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: וַֽיַּחֲנ֧וּ אֵ֦לֶּה נֹ֥כַח אֵ֖לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וַתִּקְרַב֙ הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַיַּכּ֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת־ אֲרָ֛ם מֵאָה־ אֶ֥לֶף רַגְלִ֖י בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·ḥă·nū ’êl·leh nō·ḵaḥ ’êl·leh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm way·hî bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î wat·tiq·raḇ ham·mil·ḥā·māh way·yak·kū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ’ă·rām mê·’āh- ’e·lep̄ raḡ·lî bə·yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: For seven days the armies camped opposite each other . . . . . . and on the seventh day the battle ensued and the Israelites . . . struck down the Arameans a hundred thousand foot soldiers in one day

verses.original: וַיָּנֻ֨סוּ הַנּוֹתָרִ֥ים׀ אֲפֵקָה֮ אֶל־ הָעִיר֒ וַתִּפֹּל֙ הַחוֹמָ֔ה עַל־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ הַנּוֹתָרִ֑ים וּבֶן־ הֲדַ֣ד נָ֔ס וַיָּבֹ֥א אֶל־ הָעִ֖יר חֶ֥דֶר בְּחָֽדֶר׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·nu·sū han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm ’ă·p̄ê·qāh ’el- hā·‘îr wat·tip·pōl ha·ḥō·w·māh ‘al- ‘eś·rîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’e·lep̄ ’îš han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm ū·ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ nās way·yā·ḇō ’el- hā·‘îr ḥe·ḏer bə·ḥā·ḏer
verses.literal: The rest of them fled into the city of Aphek where the wall fell on twenty-seven . . . thousand of the remaining men Ben-hadad also fled to the city and hid in an inner room . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָיו֮ עֲבָדָיו֒ הִנֵּֽה־ נָ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ כִּ֗י מַלְכֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי־ מַלְכֵ֥י חֶ֖סֶד הֵ֑ם נָשִׂ֣ימָה נָּא֩ שַׂקִּ֨ים בְּמָתְנֵ֜ינוּ וַחֲבָלִ֣ים בְּרֹאשֵׁ֗נוּ וְנֵצֵא֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אוּלַ֖י יְחַיֶּ֥ה אֶת־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw hin·nêh- nā šā·ma‘·nū kî mal·ḵê bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kî- mal·ḵê ḥe·seḏ hêm nā·śî·māh nā śaq·qîm bə·mā·ṯə·nê·nū wa·ḥă·ḇā·lîm bə·rō·šê·nū wə·nê·ṣê ’el- me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ’ū·lay yə·ḥay·yeh ’eṯ- nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the servants of Ben-hadad said to him Look now we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel . . . are merciful . . . Let us go out to the king of Israel with . . . sackcloth around our waists and ropes around our heads Perhaps he will spare your life

verses.original: וַיַּחְגְּרוּ֩ שַׂקִּ֨ים בְּמָתְנֵיהֶ֜ם וַחֲבָלִ֣ים בְּרָאשֵׁיהֶ֗ם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ עַבְדְּךָ֧ בֶן־ הֲדַ֛ד אָמַ֖ר תְּחִֽי־ נָ֣א נַפְשִׁ֑י וַיֹּ֛אמֶר הַעוֹדֶ֥נּוּ חַ֖י אָחִ֥י הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·gə·rū śaq·qîm bə·mā·ṯə·nê·hem wa·ḥă·ḇā·lîm bə·rā·šê·hem way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mə·rū ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ ’ā·mar tə·ḥî- nā nap̄·šî way·yō·mer ha·‘ō·w·ḏen·nū ḥay ’ā·ḥî hū
verses.literal: So with sackcloth around their waists and ropes around their heads they went to the king of Israel and said Your servant Ben-hadad says Please spare my life And the king answered Is he still alive He is my brother

verses.original: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֩ יְנַחֲשׁ֨וּ וַֽיְמַהֲר֜וּ וַיַּחְלְט֣וּ הֲמִמֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אָחִ֣יךָ בֶן־ הֲדַ֔ד וַיֹּ֖אמֶר בֹּ֣אוּ קָחֻ֑הוּ וַיֵּצֵ֤א אֵלָיו֙ בֶּן־ הֲדַ֔ד וַֽיַּעֲלֵ֖הוּ עַל־ הַמֶּרְכָּבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·nā·šîm yə·na·ḥă·šū way·ma·hă·rū way·yaḥ·lə·ṭū hă·mim·men·nū way·yō·mə·rū ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ way·yō·mer bō·’ū qā·ḥu·hū way·yê·ṣê ’ê·lāw ben- hă·ḏaḏ way·ya·‘ă·lê·hū ‘al- ham·mer·kā·ḇāh
verses.literal: Now the men were looking for a sign of hope and they quickly grasped at this word . . . and replied Yes, your brother Ben-hadad Go and get him said the king Then Ben-hadad came out and Ahab had him come up into his chariot

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֡יו הֶעָרִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר־ לָֽקַח־ אָבִי֩ מֵאֵ֨ת אָבִ֜יךָ אָשִׁ֗יב וְ֠חוּצוֹת תָּשִׂ֨ים לְךָ֤ בְדַמֶּ֙שֶׂק֙ כַּאֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֤ם אָבִי֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַאֲנִ֖י בַּבְּרִ֣ית אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֑ךָּ וַיִּכְרָת־ ל֥וֹ בְרִ֖ית וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer- lā·qaḥ- ’ā·ḇî mê·’êṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’ā·šîḇ wə·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ tā·śîm lə·ḵā ḇə·ḏam·me·śeq ka·’ă·šer- śām ’ā·ḇî bə·šō·mə·rō·wn wa·’ă·nî bab·bə·rîṯ ’ă·šal·lə·ḥe·kā way·yiḵ·rāṯ- lōw ḇə·rîṯ way·šal·lə·ḥê·hū
verses.literal: Ben-hadad said to him I will restore the cities my father took from your father you may set up your own marketplaces in Damascus as my father did in Samaria By this treaty I release you ,” Ahab replied So he made a treaty with him and sent him away

verses.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֜ד מִבְּנֵ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֗ים אָמַ֧ר אֶל־ רֵעֵ֛הוּ בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה הַכֵּ֣ינִי נָ֑א וַיְמָאֵ֥ן הָאִ֖ישׁ לְהַכֹּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’e·ḥāḏ mib·bə·nê han·nə·ḇî·’îm ’ā·mar ’el- rê·‘ê·hū biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh hak·kê·nî nā way·mā·’ên hā·’îš lə·hak·kō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Meanwhile, by the word of the LORD one of the sons of the prophets said to his companion Strike me please But the man refused . . . to strike him

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֙עְתָּ֙ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה הִנְּךָ֤ הוֹלֵךְ֙ מֵֽאִתִּ֔י וְהִכְּךָ֖ הָאַרְיֵ֑ה וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ מֵֽאֶצְל֔וֹ וַיִּמְצָאֵ֥הוּ הָאַרְיֵ֖ה וַיַּכֵּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw ya·‘an ’ă·šer lō- šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh hin·nə·ḵā hō·w·lêḵ mê·’it·tî wə·hik·kə·ḵā hā·’ar·yêh way·yê·leḵ mê·’eṣ·lōw way·yim·ṣā·’ê·hū hā·’ar·yêh way·yak·kê·hū
verses.literal: Then the prophet said to him Because you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD as soon as you depart from me a lion will kill you And when he left . . . a lion found him and killed him

verses.original: וַיִּמְצָא֙ אִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֔ר וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הַכֵּ֣ינִי נָ֑א וַיַּכֵּ֥הוּ הָאִ֖ישׁ הַכֵּ֥ה וּפָצֹֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·ṣā ’îš ’a·ḥêr way·yō·mer hak·kê·nî nā way·yak·kê·hū hā·’îš hak·kêh ū·p̄ā·ṣō·a‘
verses.literal: Then the prophet found another man and said Strike me please So the man struck him and wounded him . . .

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַנָּבִ֔יא וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל־ הַדָּ֑רֶךְ וַיִּתְחַפֵּ֥שׂ בָּאֲפֵ֖ר עַל־ עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ han·nā·ḇî way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ lam·me·leḵ ‘al- had·dā·reḵ way·yiṯ·ḥap·pêś bā·’ă·p̄êr ‘al- ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: and the prophet went and waited on the road for the king disguising himself with a bandage over his eyes

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ עֹבֵ֔ר וְה֖וּא צָעַ֣ק אֶל־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֜אמֶר עַבְדְּךָ֣׀ יָצָ֣א בְקֶֽרֶב־ הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְהִנֵּֽה־ אִ֨ישׁ סָ֜ר וַיָּבֵ֧א אֵלַ֣י אִ֗ישׁ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ שְׁמֹר֙ אֶת־ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֔ה אִם־ הִפָּקֵד֙ יִפָּקֵ֔ד וְהָיְתָ֤ה נַפְשְׁךָ֙ תַּ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֔וֹ א֥וֹ כִכַּר־ כֶּ֖סֶף תִּשְׁקֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ham·me·leḵ ‘ō·ḇêr wə·hū ṣā·‘aq ’el- ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer ‘aḇ·də·ḵā yā·ṣā ḇə·qe·reḇ- ham·mil·ḥā·māh wə·hin·nêh- ’îš sār way·yā·ḇê ’ê·lay ’îš way·yō·mer šə·mōr ’eṯ- hā·’îš haz·zeh ’im- hip·pā·qêḏ yip·pā·qêḏ wə·hā·yə·ṯāh nap̄·šə·ḵā ta·ḥaṯ nap̄·šōw ’ōw ḵik·kar- ke·sep̄ tiš·qō·wl
verses.literal: As the king passed by he cried out to the king Your servant had marched out into the middle of the battle when suddenly a man came over with a captive and told me Guard this man If he goes missing for any reason your life will be exchanged for his life or you will weigh out a talent of silver

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י עַבְדְּךָ֗ עֹשֵׂ֥ה הֵ֛נָּה וָהֵ֖נָּה וְה֣וּא אֵינֶ֑נּוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֧יו מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כֵּ֥ן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֖ךָ אַתָּ֥ה חָרָֽצְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ‘ō·śêh hên·nāh wā·hên·nāh wə·hū ’ê·nen·nū way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl kên miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā ’at·tāh ḥā·rā·ṣə·tā
verses.literal: But while your servant was busy here and there the man disappeared And the king of Israel said to him So shall your judgment be you have pronounced it on yourself

verses.original: וַיְמַהֵ֕ר וַיָּ֙סַר֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֲפֵ֔ר מֵעַל עֵינָ֑יו וַיַּכֵּ֤ר אֹתוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י מֵֽהַנְּבִאִ֖ים הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·ma·hêr way·yā·sar ’eṯ- hā·’ă·p̄êr mē·ʿal ‘ê·nāw way·yak·kêr ’ō·ṯōw me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl kî mê·han·nə·ḇi·’îm hū
verses.literal: Then the prophet quickly removed the bandage from his eyes and the king of Israel recognized him as one of the prophets

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה יַ֛עַן שִׁלַּ֥חְתָּ אֶת־ אִישׁ־ חֶרְמִ֖י מִיָּ֑ד וְהָיְתָ֤ה נַפְשְׁךָ֙ תַּ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֔וֹ וְעַמְּךָ֖ תַּ֥חַת עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ya·‘an šil·laḥ·tā ’eṯ- ’îš- ḥer·mî mî·yāḏ wə·hā·yə·ṯāh nap̄·šə·ḵā ta·ḥaṯ nap̄·šōw wə·‘am·mə·ḵā ta·ḥaṯ ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: And the prophet said to the king This is what the LORD says Because you have let slip from your hand the man I had devoted to destruction your life will be exchanged for his life and your people for his people

verses.original: וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַל־ בֵּית֖וֹ סַ֣ר וְזָעֵ֑ף וַיָּבֹ֖א שֹׁמְרֽוֹנָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- bê·ṯōw sar wə·zā·‘êp̄ way·yā·ḇō šō·mə·rō·w·nāh
verses.literal: Sullen and angry the king of Israel went home to Samaria
